clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan lurks the Dark Iron Ambassador, an elusive emissary sent by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. His presence reveals that the fall of the gnome capital involves far more than just wild trogg incursions and madness.

While Gnomeregan's catastrophic downfall is publicly blamed on the trogg invasion and High Tinker Mekkatorque's desperate radiation gambit, the presence of the Dark Iron Ambassador points to far darker machinations. Wandering the contaminated depths of the workshop corridors, this rare Dark Iron dwarf suggests that Sicco Thermaplugg did not betray his people in complete isolation.
